description: Audit and optionally clean up to 500 JSON rows, returning cleaned_rows, original zero-based issues and counts. Processing order is trim, primary-key deduplication, then required/range checks: keys " a " and "a" collide after trimming. Duplicate removal keeps the first row and skips later-row field checks; missing keys are retained and flagged. REVIEW persists even after repair, so inspect issues before use; [] returns ALLOW. Numeric strings are not converted or range-checked; use trust_validate_data for type enforcement. Only top-level strings are trimmed; inputs are not mutated. Free, unauthenticated, stateless pilot: rules apply only to this call. Usage metadata is recorded; request bodies are not stored.

inputSchema.description: Rows and optional deterministic cleanup settings.

numeric_ranges.description: Inclusive bounds for top-level fields that already contain numbers. Use validation for numeric type enforcement.

primary_key.description: Top-level key used for duplicate detection; defaults to id. Keys compare by JSON serialization, so 1 differs from "1".

remove_duplicates.description: Drop later rows with the same primary key; missing keys are flagged and retained. Duplicate rows are skipped before required/range checks.

required_fields.description: Top-level field names that must be present and non-null/non-empty. Checked after optional trimming.

rows.description: JSON object rows; at most 500. An empty array is valid.

trim_strings.description: Trim leading/trailing whitespace from top-level strings; nested values are unchanged.

name: trust_clean_data

outputSchema.description: Structured result, also serialized in the text content block.

cleaned_rows.description: New row objects after the selected transformations.

issues.description: Audit findings with original zero-based row positions.

items.description: A deterministic finding; codes identify the violated check.

row.description: Zero-based input row index, when applicable.

ok.description: The operation completed; does not imply the verdict is ALLOW.

verdict.description: ALLOW: no findings. REVIEW: inspect issues, including removed duplicates. BLOCK: invalid row input.

title: Audit and clean JSON rows
